    The lower bound by the matrices U_d #

    periodic-mesh-calculations.tex: "For a finite graph with adjacency matrix M, define integer matrices U_0 = I, U_1 = M, U_{d+1} = M U_d - U_{d-1}. If U_0, …, U_N are entrywise nonnegative, then (dim_k e_i Π(Δ)_N e_j)_{ij} ≥ U_N. … If K(t) records the kernels of the leftmost maps, … (I - tM + t²I) H(t) = I + K(t), H(t) = (∑ U_d t^d)(I + K(t)). The coefficients of K are nonnegative."

    We record the coefficientwise form: a sequence of vectors h_d with κ_d = h_d - M h_{d-1} + h_{d-2} ≥ 0 satisfies h_N = ∑_{e ≤ N} U_{N-e} κ_e, hence h_N ≥ U_N h_0 when U_0, …, U_N ≥ 0.
